title: Concept: RabbitMQ management interface disclosed
description: The RabbitMQ management interface is served at this endpoint, so the broker administration console is reachable from this network position.
applicability: Responses served by the RabbitMQ management plug-in.
risk: A reachable management console exposes queue names and message rates and offers publish and purge controls after login; MEDIUM because the page alone does not prove credentials are accepted.
